registration: The protocol, candidate parameters and evidence must be committed before forwardStartsAt; the Git commit provides the registration timestamp.
hypothesis: A fixed, per-stat temperature fitted on a chronological calibration window reduces the baseline's probability overconfidence on later games.
selectionMetric: Mean logarithmic loss within the calibration window, independently per stat; lower temperature wins exact ties.
historicalLimit: Proxy thresholds, not archived DFS lines. The baseline's aggregate results on this season have already been inspected. This is retrospective confirmation, not a new untouched holdout or profit test.
forwardUnit: First valid pre-lock observation per event, athlete, stat and exact line, deduplicated across platforms, within the displayed rolling 90-day window. Latest result revision; no ties or DNPs counted as directional losses. Distinct forward dates use America/New_York NBA slate dates.
promotion: Review only. No automatic model promotion, live wager, budget increase, or change to the frozen v1 ledger. Passing this probability-quality gate is not proof of profitability.
